The '''Typha-Dor High Council''' was a group of leaders of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Typha-Dor]].

The High Council consisted of the world's "twin rulers" ([[Binalu]] and [[Talus (Human)|Talus]]), its [[High General]] ([[Bycha]]), and a cadre of lesser [[General/Legends|generals]].
